title: IMPACT: an open-source workflow for unified variant interpretation using phenotype-driven filtering
task: Unified interpretation of multi-variant classes in whole-genome sequencing via phenotype-driven filtering
key_results: Deafness cohort: 565 prioritized variants (512 non-incidental); epilepsy cohort: 126 prioritized variants (103 non-incidental); 100% deafness and 87.8% epilepsy participants had candidate variants
comments: Strengths: harmonizes SNVs, indels, SVs, CNVs in interactive interface; ACMG-aligned classification is clinically relevant. Limitation: UK Biobank cohorts modest in size; requires external validation.

model_io.model: IMPACT (phenotype-configurable pipeline with R Shiny interface)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phenotype-aware filtering across variant classes identifies pathogenic and candidate variants relevant to deafness and epilepsy
hypotheses.result: 100% deafness and 87.8% epilepsy participants carried ≥1 candidate variant; identified compound heterozygotes spanning variant classes

title: Detection of lung cancer using Kronecker mobile forward harmonic net
task: Lung cancer detection from CT images using hybrid deep learning
comments: Strong performance metrics but lacks independent validation on external datasets and no comparison with state-of-the-art methods.

model_io.model: KMFHNet (MobileNet + Deep Kronecker Network + Harmonic Analysis)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher-order feature interactions via Kronecker networks improve cancer detection over standard CNNs

title: Generalizable prediction of biological contaminants across aerobic and anaerobic membrane bioreactors
task: Prediction of bacterial and viral pathogen concentrations in membrane bioreactors via lifelong learning
key_results: Accurate and generalizable prediction across aerobic/anaerobic MBRs and unseen wastewater matrices; outperformed WGAN baseline
comments: Ensemble sequential data augmentation with lifelong learning is novel; validation across multiple pathogen types (bacteria, viruses, specific phages) strengthens claims.

outputs: bacterial cell, total virus, adenovirus, PMMV, coliphage, CrAssphage concentrations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lifelong learning with data augmentation improves generalization across unseen MBRs and wastewater matrices
hypotheses.result: Maintained prediction performance and robustness on unseen treatment facilities

title: Alignment-free convolutional neural network classification of glycemic states in type 1 diabetes from GC–IMS breath spectra
task: Classification of glycemic states from breath spectra using alignment-free CNN
key_results: 86.6% (±4.0%) mean balanced accuracy; specificity >92% across all classes; robust to instrumental drift
comments: Proof-of-concept with small cohort (n=10); physiologically interpretable saliency maps strengthen findings but external validation needed for clinical utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN can classify glycemic states from breath VOCs without spectral alignment despite instrumental drift
hypotheses.result: 86.6% balanced accuracy maintained despite retention time variability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Network identifies physiologically relevant breath markers (acetone, isoprene, 2-propanol)
hypotheses.result: Saliency maps confirmed metabolic markers associated with glycemic dysregulation

title: An improved Portia spider optimized SpikeApneaNet for ECG-based sleep apnea detection with FPGA implementation
task: ECG-based sleep apnea detection using spiking neural networks with FPGA implementation
key_results: 95.83% accuracy (subject-independent 5-fold CV); 94.53% cross-dataset accuracy (UCDDB); 16 ms latency, 14.53 FPS/W power efficiency on FPGA
comments: Comprehensive hardware implementation with quantization and latency reporting is excellent; temporal spike encoding removes handcrafted feature dependence, addressing key limitation of prior work.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spike-based encoding and improved Portia spider optimization improve generalization across subjects and datasets
hypotheses.result: 95.83% subject-independent accuracy; 94.53% cross-dataset accuracy on UCDDB

hypotheses.hypothesis: FPGA quantization and hardware acceleration enable real-time, power-efficient edge inference
hypotheses.result: 16 ms latency, 0.07 J energy consumption, 62.50 FPS throughput

title: Deepfakebuster: a confidence-calibrated adaptive ensemble framework for robust Deepfake image detection
task: Deepfake image detection via confidence-calibrated adaptive ensemble
key_results: 97.8% overall accuracy on 192,000 images; heterogeneous ensemble with reliability-aware fusion outperforms individual detectors and static baselines
comments: The confidence-calibrated adaptive fusion mechanism is novel, but evaluation is limited to intra-dataset conditions; cross-dataset robustness remains untested.

model_io.model: DeepFakeBuster: adaptive ensemble with reliability-aware fusion (MLP-Mixer)
inputs: heterogeneous detector outputs (spatial, boundary, noise, semantic, frequency)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confidence-calibrated adaptive fusion outperforms static averaging and individual detectors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 97.8% ensemble accuracy vs lower individual and baseline performance

title: A novel gas detector optimisation method combining 2-of-N voting systems, kinetic theory of gases, and exceedance curves to minimise CFD requirements
task: Gas detector placement optimization using kinetic theory and Monte Carlo simulation
key_results: Mathematical model predicts flammable cloud volume with CFD-comparable accuracy while reducing CFD simulation count; 2-of-N voting improves system reliability
comments: The reduction in CFD computational burden is valuable for industrial applications, though the paper lacks quantitative metrics on CFD savings and does not specify accuracy thresholds.

model_io.model: Kinetic theory-based mathematical model with Monte Carlo simulation and set covering optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kinetic theory model with limited CFD data can estimate flammable cloud volume comparably to full CFD
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: model achieves comparable accuracy while reducing CFD simulations

hypotheses.hypothesis: 2-of-N voting logic improves gas detection system reliability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: voting constraint enhances detector reliability in optimization

title: 2D-unsteady chaotic flows for mixing two different non-Newtonian fluids: optimization and flow control
task: Mixing optimization of two shear-thinning fluids in unsteady 2D chaotic mixer
key_results: Continuous modulation 29-39% faster mixing than alternating modulation; alternating modulation saves 9-25% energy; final mixture rheology governed by more viscous fluid
comments: The trade-off analysis between mixing speed and energy efficiency is practical for industrial design, but evaluation is limited to two stirring protocols and does not explore hybrid or adaptive strategies.

model_io.model: Numerical simulation of 2D two-rod chaotic mixer with CMand ALT protocols
inputs: two shear-thinning fluids with distinct rheological properties

hypotheses.hypothesis: Continuous modulation achieves faster mixing than alternating modulation
Alternating modulation is more energy efficient than continuous modulation

title: Balancing privacy and accuracy: federated learning for multi-class student performance prediction with adaptive noise differential privacy
task: Student performance prediction with privacy-preserving federated learning
key_results: Accuracy improved from 0.9432 to 0.9516, F1 score from 0.9428 to 0.9522 using adaptive noise differential privacy
comments: Adaptive DP noise achieves marginal gains over standard DP (information entropy 0.6472 vs 0.6406) while protecting privacy, though the practical significance of <1% accuracy improvement warrants scrutiny.

model_io.model: 9-layer CNN with federated learning and adaptive noise differential privacy
inputs: student learning analytics data from OULAD

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive noise DP improves both accuracy and privacy over traditional DP
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: higher accuracy (0.9516 vs 0.9432) with comparable entropy (0.6472 vs 0.6406)

title: A dual-domain spatio-temporal and frequency framework for robust deepfake detection
task: Deepfake video detection via dual-domain spatio-temporal and frequency analysis
key_results: Intra-dataset: strong performance; cross-dataset: accuracy 50.41-62.21%, AUC 0.4776-0.7613; substantial generalization gap
comments: DSTF-Net elegantly combines wavelet and transformer approaches, but the large cross-dataset performance drop (>30% accuracy) severely limits real-world deployment without domain adaptation.

model_io.model: DSTF-Net: dual-branch architecture (WaveFormer + SFormer) with MLP-Mixer fusion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual-domain (frequency + spatio-temporal) analysis improves intra-dataset deepfake detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for intra-dataset; refuted for cross-dataset without fine-tuning (>30% accuracy drop)

title: Research on a roof weighting parameter mining system using support resistance manifestation information
task: Automated roof-weighting parameter extraction from hydraulic-support resistance data
key_results: Two-parameter clustering algorithm achieved 8.81% relative deviation in periodic weighting intervals; automated system deployed at coal mine working face 23,203
comments: The two-parameter clustering algorithm outperforms DBSCAN (8.81% vs 9.66% deviation) and eliminates manual subjectivity, though 8-9% error margins may be significant for safety-critical mining operations.

model_io.model: Two-parameter clustering algorithm with data gridding and Flask system
inputs: monitored hydraulic-support resistance data from coal mine

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-parameter clustering without pre-specified cluster count achieves comparable accuracy to DBSCAN
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 8.81% vs 9.66% relative deviation; proposed method is more automated

title: Visibility-driven compensation model for driver pupillary response in road tunnels: a GWO-XGBoost and SHAP-based interpretable framework
task: Driver pupil diameter prediction in road tunnels using GWO-XGBoost with SHAP interpretability
key_results: GWO-XGBoost achieved R² 0.914, MAPE 7.15% on test set; visibility identified as primary driver of pupil response; visibility-driven compensation model provides nonlinear relationship interpretation
comments: The integration of hyperparameter optimization, feature attribution, and psychophysiological validation is thorough; SHAP analysis bridges data-driven and mechanistic understanding, supporting tunnel lighting design.

inputs: visibility, illuminance, color temperature, tunnel geometry, external time

hypotheses.hypothesis: GWO-based hyperparameter optimization outperforms grid and random search
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: R² 0.914 and MAPE 7.15% superior to baseline methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visibility is the dominant factor in pupil response, followed by color temperature and illuminance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by SHAP analysis; visibility-driven compensation model high goodness-of-fit

title: Robust field-free superconducting diode effect in FeTe0.55Se0.45
task: Realize field-free superconducting diode effect in single material
key_results: Robust nonreciprocal critical supercurrent in FeTe0.55Se0.45 with second harmonic response comparable to first harmonic near Tc; maintains polarity under large positive/negative magnetic fields with even-in-field symmetry
comments: Local strain/polarization-induced symmetry breaking rather than conventional mechanisms (finite-momentum pairing or magnetochiral anisotropy) appears responsible, suggesting iron-based superconductors are promising platforms for practical applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Field-free SDE originates from finite-momentum pairing or magnetochiral anisotropy
hypotheses.result: Ruled out based on even-in-field symmetry and persistence at zero field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local strain/polarization breaks inversion and time-reversal symmetries to enable field-free SDE
hypotheses.result: Supported by systematic exclusion of device geometry, thermal gradients, chiral domains, and extrinsic magnetic order
